[.walkthrough]
.Reorder a form, in the view and in the Outline
. In *Edit* mode, click a component to select it. Its [.walkthrough-look]#badge# names the component type. Drag the component by the badge.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/01-select.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/01-select.jpg"]
. Drag it to its new place and release. In a form, aim for the thin strip at the left edge of a field: the component goes before that field.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/02-drag.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/02-drag.jpg"]
. When the target is small or crowded, open the [.walkthrough-look]#Outline#. It shows the view's components as a tree.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/03-outline-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/03-outline-open.jpg"]
. Drag a row in the Outline to move that component. Here, Birthday moves to the top of the form.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/04-outline-drag.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/drag-and-drop/04-outline-drag.jpg"]
